content:
maria: Quick audit — ~40 docs/examples still use model alias `redwood-embed-v1` and the old SDK call patterns. I'm proposing a single PR to: 1) update callsites to `redwood-embed-v2` where appropriate, 2) replace `stream:true` examples with streaming SDK pattern, and 3) sweep internal links to the embed dims table.

ben: 👍 can you paste the grep output or a shortlist?

maria: here's a condensed grep:
```
docs/getting-started/embedding.md: const res = client.embeddings.create({model: 'redwood-embed-v1', input})
examples/semantic-search/README.md: model: 'redwood-embed-v1'
docs/faq/embeddings.md: see table (old dims link)
```

lina: ok — I can take examples/semantic-search and examples/snippets. Will send a PR by tomorrow.

patrick: I can own the docs/* callsites. What's the recommended migration text for the deprecation note? we should avoid alarming users.

maria: Proposed blurb:
"The alias `redwood-embed-v1` is deprecated and will be removed on 2026-07-15. Please migrate to `redwood-embed-v2` which has 512 dims and improved stability. See migration guide: /docs/migrations/embeddings-v1-to-v2"

sam: small nit: indicate fallback behavior for legacy customers (we still serve v1 for accounts with pinned back-compat until sunset)

maria: good call — will add sentence: "Accounts with pinned back-compat will continue to resolve `redwood-embed-v1` until the sunset date; contact support to opt into extended access." 

lina: streaming snippet rewrite question — old example uses `stream:true` in the request body, new SDK has `client.responses.stream(...)`. Anyone have a minimal replacement I can copy?

ben: here's a tiny streaming snippet to use in JS examples:
```js
const stream = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-2', input: 'Summarize this' })
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta ?? '')
}
```

patrick: thanks — I'll adapt that for Python as well.

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 - initial sweep and model alias map. @maria @lina assigned.

maria: great. Action items:
- lina: update examples/semantic-search, snippets by 2026-05-10
- patrick: update docs/*.md callsites and migration guide by 2026-05-12
- ben: add a small rollback snippet for users pinned to v1
- sam: review deprecation wording and compliance check

sam: I'll review wording by EOD today.

ben: quick question: do we need to update the API reference table for embed dims? That's in docs/reference/embeddings.md

maria: yes — patrick pls update dims table, add a small note that v2 uses 512 dims and enumerated deprecation footnote.

lina: PR draft in progress, pushing in a bit.

maria: thanks all. We'll route communication through product-comms for external notice after docs PR lands. Ping here when merged. :thumbsup:

lina: pushed draft -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842/files — feedback welcome.

patrick: quick review done, left two minor copy comments.

sam: approved wording patch suggestions in PR.

docs-bot: PR merged by lina at 3955550085

maria: merged — assigning product/comms to draft external deprecation email. Closing internal sweep ticket once product confirms timeline.

ben: left a tiny extra snippet to handle `input: []` array variant.

maria: added to PR post-merge via followup — thanks.

lina: thanks team, closing loop here. If anyone finds more stray callsites ping me.
